mapper.sql: JOIN topics t ON t.id = l.topic_id JOIN users u ON u.id = #{userId} AND u.course = t.course
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title FROM topics t JOIN users u ON u.id = #{userId} AND u.course = t.course ORDER BY t.position

SELECT l.id, l.topic_id, l.title, l.can_do, l.est_minutes, p.completed_at FROM lessons l
LEFT JOIN lesson_progress p ON p.lesson_id = l.id AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.position

SELECT l.id, l.topic_id, l.title, l.can_do, l.est_minutes, NULL::timestamptz AS completed_at FROM lessons l
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lesson_progress p WHERE p.lesson_id = l.id AND p.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY l.position LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, can_do, scenario, ai_persona, opening_line, est_minutes FROM lessons WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, english, translation, example FROM phrases WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} ORDER BY position
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson_progress (user_id, lesson_id, completed_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{lessonId}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT l.can_do FROM lesson_progress p JOIN lessons l ON l.id = p.lesson_id
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.completed_at DESC
mapper.sql: lesson_id, glyph, name, latin, hint, isolated_form, initial_form, medial_form, final_form, say, word, word_latin, word_meaning, COALESCE("similar", '{}') AS "similar", audio_url
mapper.select: SELECT FROM letters a JOIN lessons l ON l.id = a.lesson_id ORDER BY l.position
